blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fingerspelling - the sequential signing of letters that compose proper names, technical terms, and out-of-vocabulary words - is an integral component of any sign language. Despite Russian Sign Language (RSL) being used by more than 150,000 native signers, no public fingerspelling dataset for RSL exists, in contrast to American, British, German, and several other sign languages. We introduce Znaki the first open RSL fingerspelling dataset: 37,252 video recordings (35.4 hours) of 1,593 unique sequences - proper names sampled from 16 domain categories - recorded by 68 native RSL signers (37 Deaf, 29 hard-of-hearing, and 2 certified interpreters) through a crowdsourcing pipeline with a two-stage signer qualification procedure and expert validation. The dataset covers all 33 Cyrillic handshapes, and its letter-frequency distribution matches the Russian National Corpus. As reference points for future research, we establish two baselines adapted from American Sign Language fingerspelling recognition: a Squeezeformer-based encoder-decoder, reaching a character-level accuracy ($1-\mathrm{CER}$) of 0.932 and a sequence accuracy of 0.596, and Fingerspelling-PoseNet, reaching 0.886 and 0.545, respectively.
blocks.zh: 指代(fingerspelling) -- -- 连续签名字母,这些字母组成了正名,技术名词和省外词 -- -- 是任何手语的组成部分. 尽管俄罗斯手语(RSL)被超过15万个本土签名者所使用,但相对于美国,英国,德意志等几种手语,没有用于RSL的公共指代数据集. 我们介绍Znaki的第一个开放的RSL指代数据集:37 252个录像(35.4小时),其中1 593个独特的序列 -- -- 从16个域类中抽取的正名 -- -- 由68个本地RSL签名人(37个聋人、29个难听和2个认证翻译)通过一个集约化管道录制,并附有两个阶段的签名人资格程序和专家鉴定。 该数据集覆盖了全部33个西里尔字母手帕,其字母频率分布与俄罗斯国家公司相匹配. 作为未来研究的参考点,我们设定了两个根据美国手语指代识别而改编的基线:一个以Squeezeformer为主的编码器-解码器,其字符级精度达到0.932 (1-\mathrm{CER}$),序列精度达到0.596;和Fingerspelling-PoseNet,分别达到0.886和0.545.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Sign languages are full-fledged natural languages that exhibit cultural and regional variation.
There are approximately 72 million Deaf and hard-of-hearing people worldwide, and more than 300 sign languages 2 2 2 https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/sign-language/ .
Sign language is typically the first (native) language of Deaf individuals, and without adequate education, it may remain their only language — which can hinder communication and limit access to certain products or services.
Given the limited number of sign language interpreters, automatic sign language recognition systems can help reduce communication barriers and contribute to preserving the culture of these languages. As of 2024, there are over 150,000 Deaf signers of Russian Sign Language (RSL) in Russia 3 3 3 https://voginfo.ru/about/ . The use of RSL also extends to the countries of the former Soviet Union (now the CIS countries), possibly with minor regional variations, which implies significantly wider use of RSL in the world.
blocks.zh:
手语是完全成熟的自然语言,呈现出文化和区域差异.
全世界约有7 200万聋人和听力困难的人,300多种手语 2 2 2 https://education.nationalgeography.org/resource/sign-language/ 。 。 。 。
手语一般是聋人的第一种(本土)语言,如果没有适当的教育,手语可能仍然是他们唯一的语言——这会阻碍沟通,限制获得某些产品或服务.
鉴于手语翻译人数有限,自动手语识别系统可以帮助减少沟通障碍并有助于维护这些语言的文化. 截至2024年,俄罗斯有超过15万名俄语手语(RSL)的聋人签名者 3 3 3 s://voginfo.ru/ about/. RSL的使用也扩展到了前苏联国家(现为独联体国家),可能存在小的区域差异,这意味着世界上对RSL的使用要大得多.

blocks.en:
Sign language comprises manual and non-manual components.
Signs can be classified based on their articulation into one-handed and two-handed signs, with two-handed signs being either symmetrical (both hands perform identical movements) or asymmetrical (one hand performs the primary movement while the other serves a supporting role). In RSL, each of the four manual components of a sign — handshape, location, orientation, and movement — contributes to the meaning of the sign.
In RSL, fingerspelling is primarily used to represent proper names, technical and specialized terms, words for which no conventional sign exists, as well as words that are conventionally fingerspelled — such as ‘‘зал’’ ( zal , “hall”) and ‘‘как’’ ( kak , “how”). The ability to recognize fingerspelling — an integral part of sign language — is an important step toward full sign language recognition.

符号可以根据其表达为单手和双手的符号进行分类,双手的符号要么是对称的(双手都进行相同的运动),要么是不对称的(一只手执行主运动而另一只则发挥辅助作用). 在RSL中,一个标志的四个手动组件——手巾,位置,取向和移动——每个部分都有助于标志的意义.

blocks.en:
The Russian language has 33 letters, which correspond to 33 unique fingerspelling signs (handshapes) in RSL (see Figure 1 ).
Handshapes are produced with a single dominant hand, approximately at chest level, with each letter being clearly articulated.
Fingerspelling recognition is complicated by the presence of dynamic signs ( ‘‘Д’’, ‘‘Ё’’, ‘‘З’’, ‘‘Й’’, ‘‘Ц’’, ‘‘Щ’’, ‘‘Ъ’’, ‘‘Ь’’ — D, Yo, Z, Y, Ts, Shch, hard sign, soft sign ) and signs with similar hand configurations — such as ‘‘Ш’’ ( Sh ) and ‘‘Щ’’ ( Shch ), ‘‘Е’’ ( E ) and ‘‘Ё’’ ( Yo ), ‘‘И’’ ( I ) and ‘‘Й’’ ( Y ), and ‘‘Р’’ ( R ) and ‘‘Н’’ ( N ).

blocks.en:
This paper presents an efficient data collection methodology and a new fingerspelling dataset for Russian Sign Language recognition.
The main contributions of this paper are as follows: • Znaki, the first publicly available fingerspelling dataset for RSL, comprising 37,252 videos (35.4 hours) of 1,593 unique proper names recorded by 68 native RSL signers. • A Deaf-community-informed phrase sampling covering all 33 Cyrillic handshapes and 696 letter bigrams, with a letter-frequency distribution matching the Russian National Corpus. • A two-stage signer qualification procedure — an RSL proficiency exam followed by a fingerspelling distractor test. • Baseline results from two pose-based fingerspelling recognition architectures previously developed for American Sign Language (ASL).
blocks.zh:

本文主要贡献如下: • Znaki,为RSL首个可公开使用的指针拼接数据集,由68个本地RSL签名人录制的37,252个视频(35.4小时)出自1,593个独特的正名. · 一个聋人社区知情的词组抽样,涵盖所有33个西里尔管和696个字母大写字母,其字母频率分布与俄罗斯国家公司相符。 • 两个阶段的签字人资格审查程序——RSL能力考试,然后是指尖分辨器测试。 • 基线是以前为美国手语(ASL)开发的两套假名识别结构。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Sign language recognition has been an active area of research for many years. Early approaches primarily focused on image-based recognition of static hand signs in ASL Barczak et al. (2011) ; Kang et al. (2015) , RSL Makarov et al. (2019) , BdSL Podder et al. (2020) , and other sign languages Szyszka (2021) ; Kenshimov et al. (2021) . Nevertheless, dynamic signs are present in virtually all sign languages, and recognizing them necessitates capturing the temporal dimension of the sign.
Robust fingerspelling recognition therefore requires a dataset comprising video samples. At present, two categories of fingerspelling data are publicly available: isolated handshapes (individual letters) and continuous fingerspelling (complete words or phrases). Table 1 summarizes the publicly available resources most relevant to our work.
blocks.zh:
多年来,手语识别一直是积极的研究领域. 早期办法主要侧重于在ASL Barczak等人(2011年);Kang等人(2015年),RSL中对静态手迹的图像识别 Makarov等 (2019), BdSL Podder等 (2020), 以及其他手语 Szyszka (2021); Kenshimov等 (2021). 然而,几乎所有手语都有动态标志,要认识到这些标志就必须抓住标志的时间维度。
因此,要识别强力的手指,就需要一套由视频样本组成的数据集。 目前,有两类指针数据可以公开获取:孤立的指针(个别字母)和连续指针(完整的单词或短语). 表1概述了与我们的工作最相关的公开资源。

blocks.en: As noted in Section 1 , no continuous fingerspelling datasets exist for RSL.
blocks.zh: 如第1节所指出,RSL没有连续的指代数据集。

blocks.en: Table 1: Publicly available fingerspelling datasets. Znaki is the first continuous fingerspelling dataset for RSL.
blocks.zh: 表1:可公开使用的指尖数据集。 Znaki是第一个用于RSL的连续指尖数据集.

blocks.en: 2.1 Isolated Handshape Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 孤立的手巾数据集

blocks.en: One of the earliest fingerspelling datasets, the RWTH German Fingerspelling Database Dreuw et al. (2006) , contains 1,400 video sequences (320 × \times 240 and 352 × \times 288 resolution, 25 fps) representing 35 DGS signs recorded from 20 participants across two sessions. Each sign was captured simultaneously by two cameras from different viewpoints under varying lighting and background conditions. Participants wore no special clothing and received no training, making the dataset more representative for unconstrained recognition systems.
blocks.zh: 最早的指心数据集之一为RWTH德国指心数据库Dreuw等(2006年),包含有1400个视频序列(320相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 在不同的照明和背景条件下,两个来自不同观点的相机同时捕捉到每个标志. 与会者不穿特殊服装,也不接受培训,使数据集更能代表不受限制的识别系统。

blocks.en: The Nepali Sign Language dataset (NSL23) Sunuwar et al. (2023) is the first dataset for NSL, containing 630 videos (1,205 signs) representing 36 consonants and 13 vowels. Recordings were collected from 14 volunteers (9 beginners, 5 experts) under various conditions (normal lighting, low lighting, prepared/unprepared, and real-world environments).
blocks.zh: 尼泊尔手语数据集(NSL23) Sunuwar等 (2023)是NSL的第一个数据集,包含630个视频(1,205个符号),代表了36个相和和13个元音. 从14名志愿人员(9名初学者、5名专家)收集了各种条件(正常照明、低照明、准备/准备不足和现实世界环境)的记录。

blocks.en: For RSL handshapes, two datasets are known: the publicly available Bukva dataset Kvanchiani et al. (2024) and the private NSTU dataset Grif and Kondratenko (2021) . The Bukva dataset comprises 3,757 videos covering all 33 letters of the Russian alphabet, with an average of 113 videos per class (49 frames per video). Recorded by 155 signers — including Deaf individuals, RSL learners, and teachers — the dataset represents a wide age range (9 to 81 years). The NSTU dataset comprises 13,412 images and videos of 33 Russian fingerspelling signs recorded from four signers (waist-up, right hand at chest level). Due to the limited signer diversity, the authors augmented the dataset with an additional 1,566 samples collected from YouTube and custom recordings to improve real-world performance.
blocks.zh: 对于RSL handhapes,已知有两套数据集:可公开获取的布克瓦数据集克万奇亚尼等(2024年)和私有的NSTU数据集格里夫和孔德拉滕科(2021年). 布克瓦数据集由3,757个视频组成,覆盖了俄罗斯字母的所有33个字母,每个班平均有113个视频(每个视频49帧). 由155名签字人(包括聋人、RSL学习者和教师)录制的数据集代表了广泛的年龄范围(9-81岁)。 NSTU数据集包含13 412个图像和录像,其中33个俄罗斯指针标出4个签名者(胸前为右手)所记录。 由于签名者的多样性有限,作者们增加了数据集,从YouTube和定制录音中收集了1 566个样本,以改善现实世界的表现。

blocks.en: Moreover, general sign language datasets commonly include a collection of handshapes as well LI et al. (2020) ; Kapitanov et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 此外,一般手语数据集通常包括收集的手巾以及LI等人(2020年);Kapitanov等人(2023年)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Continuous Fingerspelling Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.2 连续用手指拼接数据集

blocks.en: Among the first large-scale ASL fingerspelling collections are the ChicagoFSWild Shi et al. (2019b) and ChicagoFSWild+ Shi et al. (2019a) datasets. ChicagoFSWild was collected from online sources (YouTube, ASLized, and deafvideo.tv). The authors collected 214 raw ASL videos and manually annotated all fingerspelling clips, resulting in 7,304 sequences from 168 signers. The dataset includes proper nouns, other words, and abbreviations. Like ChicagoFSWild, the ChicagoFSWild+ dataset was also collected from online sources; however, annotation of the fingerspelling sequences was performed through a crowdsourcing platform. ChicagoFSWild+ contains 55,232 sequences from 260 signers in total, split into 50,402 training sequences (216 signers), 3,115 development sequences (22 signers), and 1,715 test sequences (22 signers).
blocks.zh: 最早的大规模ASL指尖集有ChicagoFS Wild Shi等 (2019b)和ChicagoFS Wild+. 史等 (2019a)数据集. 芝加哥 FSWild是从在线来源(YouTube、ASLized和聋哑视频.tv)收集的。 作者收集了214个原始的ASL视频并手动注释了所有指片片段,结果从168个签名者中产生了7,304个序列. 数据集包括正名名词,其他单词和缩写. 和ChicagoFSWild一样,ChicagoFSWild+数据集也从在线来源被收集;不过,指尖序列的注释是通过众包平台进行的. ChicagoFSWild+包含来自260个签名人的55,232个序列,分出为50,402个训练序列(216个签名),3,115个开发序列(22个签名)和1,715个测试序列(22个签名).

blocks.en: The FSboard dataset Georg et al. (2024) contains 151,000 sequences with an average length of 21 characters, totaling 3.2 million characters and 266 hours of video — recorded entirely on smartphones — making it the largest previously available ASL fingerspelling dataset. It includes 147 unique signers split into training (117), validation (15), and test (15) sets with no phrase overlap between splits. FSboard includes numbers alongside fingerspelling and covers five phrase domains: MacKenzie phrases, random URLs, random street addresses, random names, and random phone numbers.
blocks.zh: FSboard数据集Georg等 (2024)包含有15.1万个序列,平均长度为21个字符,总计有320万个字符和266个小时的视频——全用智能手机录制——使其成为此前最大的可得到的ASL指针数据集. 它包括147个被分解为训练(117个),验证(15个),测试(15个)的特有签名器,而分解器之间没有短语重叠. FSboard包括数字与指针并列,涵盖五个短语域: 麦肯齐语短语,随机URL,随机街道地址,随机名称,以及随机电话号码.

blocks.en: The FS23K dataset Chan et al. (2026) contains 23K BSL fingerspelling instances with letter-level annotations and 133K temporal boundaries. It comprises 23K words, 139K letter annotations, 920K frames, 10.5 hours of video, and 27 signers. The letter distribution closely follows natural frequencies from BBC broadcast data.
blocks.zh: FS23K 数据集 陈等. (2026)包含有23K BSL 指代实例,并有字母级别说明和133K时间边界. 其中包括23K字、139K字母说明、920K帧、10.5小时录像和27个签名人。 信件的发售密切跟随BBC广播数据的自然频率.

blocks.en: The most recent resource, BANZ-FS Shen et al. (2026) , is the first large-scale dataset of two-handed fingerspelling in BANZSL — the manual alphabet shared by British, Australian, and New Zealand Sign Languages. It comprises 35,028 fingerspelling instances (over 200K fingerspelled characters) from 116 signers, compiled from three heterogeneous sources: sign-interpreted news broadcasts, controlled laboratory recordings, and web vlogs. Each instance carries multi-level alignment (video to subtitles, fingerspelled letters, and target lexicons), and the dataset supports four benchmark tasks: isolated fingerspelling recognition, fingerspelling detection, detection-then-recognition, and fingerspelling recognition in the context of continuous signing.
blocks.zh: 最新的资源是BANZ-FS Shen等 (2026年),是BANZSL中第一个由两手指尖拼接而成的大规模数据集——由英国,澳大利亚,新西兰手语共同使用的手动字母表. 它包括来自116个签名人的35 028个指针实例(超过200K个指针拼写字符),这些签名来自三个不同来源:由签名翻译的新闻广播、受控制的实验室录音和网络活字。 每个实例都带有多层次的对接(视频到字幕,指拼字母,以及目标词汇),数据集支持四个基准任务:孤立的指指识别,指指检测,检测时的识别,以及连续签名情况下的指指识别.

blocks.en: Znaki differs from these recent resources in both language and collection methodology. FSboard, FS23K, and BANZ-FS cover ASL and BANZSL — with BANZ-FS specifically targeting the two-handed BANZSL alphabet — whereas Znaki addresses the one-handed manual alphabet of RSL, for which no continuous fingerspelling data was previously available. Furthermore, unlike datasets mined from broadcast or web footage, all Znaki recordings were collected specifically for the dataset through a crowdsourcing pipeline with a two-stage signer qualification procedure and subsequent expert validation, providing explicit control over signer proficiency, phrase coverage, and annotation quality.
blocks.zh: 兹纳基在语言和收集方法上都与这些最新资源不同. FSboard、FS23K和BANZ-FS覆盖了ASL和BANZSL,其中BANZ-FS专门针对的是双手的BANZSL字母表,而Znaki则针对的是单手的RSL人工字母表,此前没有连续的指形数据。 此外,与从广播或网络录像中挖掘出来的数据集不同,所有兹纳基录音都是通过一个具有两阶段签字人资格程序和随后的专家鉴定的众包管道专门为数据集收集的,对签字人的熟练程度、语句覆盖面和注释质量提供了明确的控制。

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Collection
blocks.zh: 3 数据集收集

blocks.en:
Sign language datasets are typically collected using one of three common approaches: (1) studio recordings, (2) recordings sourced from the internet or television broadcasts, and (3) crowdsourcing platforms. The first method suffers from several limitations: a small number of participants and limited clothing diversity; limited variation in backgrounds and lighting; low diversity of recording devices; and overly idealized signing resulting from expert supervision during recording. The limitations of the second approach include a limited number of signers and, most critically, the necessity of additional data filtering, processing, and annotation. The third method avoids many of the limitations listed above; however, it requires a well-established data collection pipeline involving expert validation procedures.
The Znaki dataset was collected using the crowdsourcing platform TagMe 4 4 4 https://tagme.sberdevices.ru . Figure 2 provides samples from the Znaki dataset.
The data collection pipeline consisted of the following stages: signer recruitment, video collection, video validation, video processing, and video annotation.
blocks.zh:
手语数据集的收集一般采用三种常见方法之一:(1)录音室录音,(2)从互联网或电视广播中取出录音,(3)众包平台. 第一种方法有几种限制:参与者人数少,服装多样性有限;背景和照明的差别有限;录音设备的多样化程度低;在录音过程中由于专家监督,签名过于理想化。 第二种办法的局限性包括签字者人数有限,而且最重要的是,必须增加数据过滤、处理和注释。 第三种方法避免了上述许多限制;然而,它要求有一个完善的数据收集管道,包括专家验证程序。
Znaki数据集是使用众包平台TagMe 4 4 4 https://tagme.sberdevices.ru收集的. 图2提供了Znaki数据集的样本。
数据收集管道包括以下阶段:招牌、录像收集、录像验证、录像处理和录像注释。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Sample frames from the Znaki dataset.
blocks.zh: 图 2:来自兹纳基数据集的样本帧.

blocks.en: 3.1 RSL Experts
blocks.zh: 3.1 共和国军专家

blocks.en: RSL experts included Deaf or hard-of-hearing individuals and certified interpreters with relevant qualifications. The majority were members of the VOG (All-Russian Society of the Deaf) 5 5 5 https://voginfo.ru/ community, including RSL researchers and teachers. These experts were responsible for screening participants during the project admission stages and were also granted access to video verification and annotation tasks.
blocks.zh: RSL专家包括聋人或听力困难的人和具有相关资格的认证口译员。 多数是VOG(全俄罗斯聋人协会)的成员,5 5 5 https://voginfo.ru/社区,包括RSL研究人员和教师. 这些专家负责在项目录取阶段筛选参与者,并获准参加视频核查和注释工作。

blocks.en: 3.2 Phrase Selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 词组选择

blocks.en: Since fingerspelling is primarily used for signing proper names, only words and phrases belonging to this group were selected for the dataset. We consulted with Deaf experts and identified the 16 most common categories of proper names (see Table 2 ), selecting approximately 100 well-known words and phrases for each category. The proper names for each category were generated using GPT-4o OpenAI (2024) , a large language model (LLM) developed by OpenAI (the prompt template is provided in Appendix A ). All generated words and phrases were subsequently verified by RSL experts and manually refined when necessary. The resulting phrases contain between 1 and 4 proper names, with an average of 1.4 words ( σ = 0.6 \sigma=0.6 ), and range from 3 to 29 (excluding the space character) characters in length, with an average of 10,0 characters ( σ = 4.1 \sigma=4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 由于手指拼音主要用于签名正名,因此只选择了属于这个组的单词和词组入选数据集. 我们与聋人专家进行了磋商,确定了16个最常见的适当名称类别(见表2),为每个类别选择了大约100个著名字和短语。 每个类别的正则名称都是使用由OpenAI开发的大语言模型(LLM)GPT-4o OpenAI (2024)生成的(快捷模板见附录A.). 所有生成的文字和短语随后都由塞拉利昂共和国专家核实,并在必要时手工改进。 由此产生的词组包含1到4个正名,平均为1.4个字(σ=0.6\sigma=0.6),长度从3到29个字符(不包括空格字符)不等,平均为10,0个字符(σ= 4.1\sigma= 4.1).

blocks.en: Table 2: The number of unique samples in each category of the Znaki dataset.
blocks.zh: 表2:兹纳基数据集每类中的独特样本数量.

blocks.en: 3.3 Signer Selection
blocks.zh: 3.3 选择标志

blocks.en: We specifically sought to recruit Deaf or hard-of-hearing signers who are members of the VOG community. However, the platform did not restrict projects to specific user groups — they were accessible to all annotators. To ensure data quality, we implemented a two-stage screening process.
blocks.zh: 我们特别设法招募聋人或听力困难的签字人,他们是VOG社区的成员。 然而,该平台并没有将项目局限于特定的用户群体——所有注释者都可以访问。 为确保数据质量,我们实施了两个阶段的筛选程序。

blocks.en: RSL knowledge exam. Candidates were required to pass a knowledge test of RSL, which involved recording a video translating Russian sentences into RSL. RSL experts and RSL teachers evaluated the correctness of the submissions and determined whether candidates would proceed to the next test. This exam made it possible to assess the candidates’ RSL proficiency and their ability to understand and follow task instructions.
blocks.zh: RSL知识考试. 要求候选人通过RSL知识测试,包括录制将俄语判决翻译成RSL的视频。 职业介绍所专家和职业介绍所教师评估了提交材料的正确性,并确定候选人是否将参加下一次测试。 这次考试评估了考生的RSL能力及其理解和遵循任务指示的能力。

blocks.en: Fingerspelling exam. Candidates who passed the RSL exam were then required to complete an additional fingerspelling test. This test consisted of 15 tasks. In each task, candidates watched a video of RSL fingerspelling and had to select the correct Russian translation from a list of words, with a time limit of 30 seconds per task. The videos were recorded by RSL experts, who also created the incorrect response options. These experts deliberately designed plausible distractors that could be mistaken for the correct answer due to a candidate’s lack of knowledge or attention. A score of at least 85% correct answers was required to pass. 68 candidates out of 100 were accepted to the main tasks.
blocks.zh: 指指相试. 然后,通过RSL考试的候选人必须完成额外的指尖测试。 这项测试包括15项任务。 在每项任务中,考生都观看了RSL指尖的视频,不得不从单词列表中选择正确的俄文译名,每次任务的时限为30秒. 视频由RSL专家录制,他们也创造了错误的响应选项. 这些专家故意设计了可信的分心器,由于候选人缺乏知识或关注,这些分心器可能被误认为正确答案。 必须通过至少85%的正确答案。 在100名候选人中,有68人接受了主要任务。

blocks.en: 3.4 Video Collection
blocks.zh: 3.4 录像收藏

blocks.en:
The video collection task was accompanied by written instructions describing the recording rules and quality requirements.
Additionally, signers were provided with a video in which RSL teachers explained the same instructions in sign language.
blocks.zh:
录像收集任务附有说明录音规则和质量要求的书面指示。
此外,还向签字人提供了录像,RSL教师用手语解释了同样的说明。

blocks.en:
The recording rules were as follows: (1) only one person could appear in the video; (2) the signing hand had to remain fully within the frame; and (3) camera shaking and visual effects were not permitted.
The platform verification process accepted only videos with a minimum HD resolution, a duration exceeding one second, and a frame rate of at least 15 fps.
Duplicate videos were rejected, and signers were allowed to re-record submissions.
blocks.zh:
录音规则如下: (1)视频中只能出现一人; (2)签名手必须完全留在框内; (3)相机摇晃和视觉效果不允许.
平台校验过程仅接受最低HD分辨率,持续时间超过一秒,帧率至少为15 fps.
复制的视频被拒绝,并允许签字人重新记录提交材料。

blocks.en:
Signers could record videos in arbitrary environments, making the dataset heterogeneous with respect to recording conditions.
To further increase data diversity, a daily limit of 30 tasks per signer was enforced.
Figure 3 illustrates an example of a video recording task.
blocks.zh:
签字者可以在任意的环境中录制视频,使数据集在录制条件方面多种多样。
为了进一步增加数据多样性,每天执行每个签字人30个任务的限制。
图3举例说明了录像工作。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Task for recording the proper name «Виктор Гюго» (Victor Hugo).
blocks.zh: 图3:记录正名的任务 QQ (维克多·雨果).

blocks.en: 3.5 Video Validation
blocks.zh: 3.5 视频验证

blocks.en:
Each video was checked for the correctness of the translation from Russian into RSL fingerspelling sequences.
The videos were validated by a diverse group of participants, including Deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals, certified RSL interpreters, and RSL teachers and educators, all of whom confirmed their proficiency in Russian Sign Language. Validators also verified that each video complied with the recording requirements.
blocks.zh:
检查了每一段录像,以了解从俄文译成RSL指尖序列的正确性。
这些录像得到不同参与者的验证,包括聋人和听力困难的人、经认证的RSL口译员以及RSL的教师和教育工作者,他们都确认他们精通俄语手语。 验证员还核实每段录像都符合录音要求。

blocks.en: To become a validator, crowdworkers were required to complete the mandatory qualifying tasks described in Section 3.3 , undergo training, and pass a video validation exam.
blocks.zh: 要成为鉴定人,需要群众工作者完成第3.3节所述的强制性合格任务,接受培训,并通过视频鉴定考试。

blocks.en:
Each video was reviewed by at least three validators.
In cases of insufficient inter-annotator agreement, additional validators were recruited until a satisfactory level of consensus was achieved. Overall, 82% of the samples received unanimous validator agreement, i.e., inter-annotator agreement of the validation judgments, indicating a high level of annotation reliability. On average, validating a single video took 17.3 seconds.
blocks.zh:
每段录像至少由3名验证员审查。
在通知人之间协议不足的情况下,征聘了更多的核证人,直到取得令人满意的共识。 总体而言,82%的样本获得了一致的验证协议,即验证判决的注释人之间的协议,表明注释的可靠性很高. 平均来说,验证一个视频需要17.3秒.

blocks.en: Approximately 12% of the collected videos were rejected during expert validation due to signing errors or failure to comply with the recording requirements and instructions.
blocks.zh: 大约12%的所收录的录像在专家验证期间因签名错误或未遵守录音要求和说明而被拒绝。

blocks.en: 3.6 Time Interval Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.6 时间间隔说明

blocks.en:
Time interval annotation was required to separate the sign sequence from other activity periods (see Figure 4 ). As in the validation stage, crowdworkers received training and passed an exam to gain access to the annotation tasks.
Validated videos were processed to 30 frames per second (fps) to ensure consistent time alignment. Each video was annotated by three users, and the annotations were subsequently aggregated into a single result using an open-source aggregation framework 6 6 6 https://github.com/ai-forever/aggme ; 95% of the videos achieved an agreement level above 80%. This annotation approach made it possible to determine the fingerspelling speed, with an average rate of 3.2 signs (letters) per second. Importantly, the signing rate was not strongly dependent on the sequence length, as the standard deviation was only 0.1 signs per second.
blocks.zh:
需要时间间隔注释来区分标志序列和其他活动期(见图4)。 与验证阶段一样,群众工作者也接受了培训并通过了考试,以获得解说任务.
经验证的视频被处理到每秒30帧(fps),以确保时间一致. 每段视频由3个用户注释,之后使用开源汇总框架6 6 6 https://github.com/ai-forever/aggme将说明汇总为单一结果;95%的视频达到80%以上的协议水平. 这种注解方法使得能够确定指尖速度,平均速度为每秒3.2个标志(字母). 重要的是,签署率并不强烈依赖于序列长度,因为标准偏差仅为每秒0.1个标志.

blocks.en: Note that the annotations mark the boundaries of the entire fingerspelled sequence (start and end); the dataset does not include frame-level or letter-level segmentation. Reliable letter boundaries are difficult and costly to annotate at scale, since adjacent handshapes blend into one another due to coarticulation (cf. FS23K Chan et al. (2026) , where letter boundaries were annotated for a substantially smaller collection). We discuss the implications of this design choice in the Limitations section.
blocks.zh: 注意说明会标出整个指拼音序列(起止)的边界;数据集不包括帧相或字母相分. 可靠的字母界限很难进行规模说明,而且费用高昂,因为相邻的手帕由于拼接而相互混合(参见FS23K) Chan et al. (2026),其中字母边界被注释为大为较小的集合. 我们在限制部分讨论了这一设计选择的影响。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Illustration of the annotation scheme for fingerspelling sequence boundaries (start and end).
blocks.zh: 图4:指针序列边界(起始和结束)注解方案说明。

blocks.en: 3.7 Dataset Characteristics
blocks.zh: 3.7 数据集特征

blocks.en: Signers. The dataset was recorded by 68 signers, including 37 Deaf individuals, 29 hard-of-hearing individuals, and two sign language interpreters (see Figure 5 ). The signers are aged from 20 to 54 years, with 52 women and 16 men.
blocks.zh: 签名者. 数据集由68名签字人记录,其中包括37名聋人、29名听力困难的人和两名手语翻译(见图5)。 签字者年龄为20至54岁,其中52名为女性,16名为男性。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Age and gender distribution in the Znaki dataset.
blocks.zh: 图5:兹纳基数据集的年龄和性别分布。

blocks.en: Sequences. The dataset contains 1,593 unique proper names, covering all 33 letters of the Russian alphabet and 696 letter bigrams ( ≈ \approx 64% of all possible combinations). The letter-frequency distribution in Znaki corresponds to that of the Russian National Corpus 7 7 7 https://ruscorpora.ru/en/ (see Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh: 序经. 数据集包含1,593个独特的正名,覆盖了俄罗斯字母表上的所有33个字母和696个字母bigrams (\\\大约占所有可能组合的64%). 兹纳基的字母频率分布与俄罗斯国家公司7 7 https://ruscorpora.ru/en/对应 (见图6)。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Comparison of letter frequencies in the Znaki dataset and the Russian National Corpus.
blocks.zh: 图6:兹纳基数据集和俄罗斯国家公司字母频率比较.

blocks.en:
Videos. Znaki contains 37,252 videos (35.4 hours in total) with a minimum frame side of 720 pixels, trimmed according to the time interval annotations, resulting in about 42 GB of data.
Each sequence was recorded by between 8 and 41 different signers, averaging 23 videos per phrase. The average length of each sequence is 102 frames (see Figure 7 ). More than 80% of the dataset’s videos are in Full HD format, and the rest are in HD. About 88% of the samples were recorded on a phone camera, and the rest on a laptop.
blocks.zh:
视频. Znaki包含37,252个视频(共35.4小时),最小帧面为720像素,根据时间间隔说明进行修剪,结果数据约为42GB.
每个序列由8到41个不同的签名者录制,平均每个短语有23个视频. 每个序列的平均长度为102帧(见图7)。 超过80%的数据集视频采用全HD格式,其余为HD. 大约88%的样本被记录在电话相机上,其余的则被记录在笔记本电脑上.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Znaki dataset statistics: a) video length distribution; b) distance distribution, where the distance to the camera is approximately estimated in meters by computing the length between the signer’s left and right shoulders using MediaPipe Lugaresi et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: 图7:兹纳基数据集统计数据: (a)视频长度分布; (b)相距分布,通过使用MediaPipe Lugaresi等人(2019年)计算签名者左肩和右肩之间的长度,与相机相距大约以米数估算.

blocks.en: Split. The initial collection comprised more than 50,000 videos. To avoid potential data leakage — specifically, to ensure no overlap of phrases or signers between training, validation, and test sets — a portion of the data was deliberately excluded from the final dataset. We split the dataset into training (58%), validation (23%), and test (19%) sets, each containing unique phrases only: 743, 300, and 550, respectively. No signers from the test set overlap with the training and validation sets. Additionally, we ensured a proportional distribution of letters across the splits (see Figure 8 ).
blocks.zh: 分开 最初收集的视频超过5万个。 为了避免潜在的数据泄漏——具体地说,确保培训、验证和测试组合之间的短语或签名者不相重叠——一部分数据被故意排除在最后数据集之外。 我们把数据集分为培训(58%)、验证(23%)和测试(19%)两个组,每个组只包含独特的短语:分别为743、300和550个。 测试集中没有任何签名者与培训和验证集重叠. 此外,我们确保了字母在各分数之间的比例分配(见图8)。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Distribution of the total number of letters across the dataset splits.
blocks.zh: 图8:各数据集拆分的字母总数分布.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The goal of our experiments is not to introduce a new recognition architecture, but to validate the proposed dataset as a viable benchmark for RSL fingerspelling recognition. Since no publicly available benchmark for this task currently exists, we establish baseline results using two publicly available fingerspelling recognition models Henkel (2023) ; Fayyazsanavi et al. (2023) originally developed for ASL.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验目标不是引入新的识别架构,而是验证拟议数据集,作为RSL指尖识别的可行基准. 由于目前还没有关于这项任务的公开基准,我们利用两个公开的指头识别模型Henkel(2023年);Fayyazsanavi等人(2023年)确定基线结果。

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on a single H100 80 GB GPU with 12 CPU cores and 244 GB RAM. Training each model required approximately 14 GPU hours. Training hyperparameters are listed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在单H100 80 GB GPU上进行的,配有12个CPU核和244 GB RAM. 每个模式的培训需要大约14个GPU小时。 培训超参数列于附录B。

blocks.en: Dataset Split. No additional preprocessing or modifications were applied to the proposed train/validation/test split. The models were trained on the training set, validated on the validation set, and evaluated on the test set.
blocks.zh: 数据集分拆. 对拟议的列车/验证/测试分拆没有进行额外的预处理或修改. 这些模型接受了培训,在鉴定组上进行了鉴定,在测试组上进行了评估。

blocks.en: Input Representation. We used MediaPipe Holistic Grishchenko and Bazarevsky (2020) to extract a total of 543 landmarks per frame: 33 pose landmarks, 21 landmarks for each hand, and 468 facial landmarks.
blocks.zh: 投入代表。 我们用MediaPipe Holistic Grishchenko和Bazarevsky(2020年)提取出每帧共计543个地标:33个地标,21个地标,以及468个面部地标.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate our models using two complementary metrics: Character Error Rate (CER) and Accuracy (Acc). CER measures the edit distance between the predicted and ground-truth character sequences. To improve interpretability (higher is better), we report 1 − CER 1-\mathrm{CER} , where a value of 1.0 corresponds to perfect character-level prediction:
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 我们使用两个互补的衡量标准来评估我们的模型:字符误差率和精确度。 CER测量预测字符序列和地真字符序列之间的编辑距离. 为了提高可解释性(更高的更好),我们报告1−CER 1-\mathrm{CER},其中1.0的值与完美的字符级预测相对应:

blocks.en: 1 − CER = 1 − S + D + I N , 1-\mathrm{CER}=1-\frac{S+D+I}{N},
blocks.zh: 1 — CER = 1 — S + D + I N, 1-\ mathrm{ CER}=1-\ frac{ S+D+I}{N},

blocks.en: where S S is the number of substitutions, D D is the number of deletions, I I is the number of insertions, and N N is the total number of characters in the ground-truth sequence.
blocks.zh: 其中S S 为替换数,D D为删除数,I为插入数,N N为地真序列中字符总数.

blocks.en: Accuracy is defined as the proportion of completely correct sequence predictions (all characters in the correct order) relative to the total number of test samples:
blocks.zh: 准确性被定义为完全正确的序列预测(所有字符按正确的顺序排列)相对于测试样品总数的比例:

blocks.en: Acc = # fully correct sequences # total sequences . \mathrm{Acc}=\frac{\text{\# fully correct sequences}}{\text{\# total sequences}}.
blocks.zh: Acc =#完全正确序列#总序列. \ mathrm{ Acc}=\frac\ text{\# 完全正确的序列 QQTextQQ总序列.

blocks.en: 4.2 Baseline Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线模式

blocks.en: We benchmark the dataset using two publicly available architectures previously proposed for ASL fingerspelling recognition.
blocks.zh: 我们使用先前为ASL指代识别提出的两种公开结构来基准数据集。

blocks.en: Transformer-Based. Our first baseline is based on the winning solution of the Kaggle ASL Fingerspelling competition Henkel (2023) . The architecture employs an improved Squeezeformer encoder adapted for MediaPipe landmark sequences together with a two-layer transformer decoder for sequence prediction. From the full set of extracted landmarks, the model uses a subset of 130 per frame: 42 hand landmarks (21 per hand), 12 pose landmarks, and 76 facial landmarks.
blocks.zh: 变形金刚. 我们的第一个基线是基于Kaggle ASL指针拼接比赛(2023年)的获胜解决方案. 该建筑采用了为MediaPipe地标序列所改造的改进型Squeezeformer编码器,并配有用于序列预测的两层变压器解码器. 从被取出的全部地标上看,该模型使用了每帧130个子集:42个手取地标(21个手取地标),12个姿势地标,76个面部地标.

blocks.en: Fingerspelling-PoseNet. Our second baseline is based on Fingerspelling-PoseNet Fayyazsanavi et al. (2023) , a pose-based transformer encoder-decoder architecture designed for fingerspelling recognition from hand pose sequences. The model operates on the 21 2D landmarks of the automatically detected signing hand and performs autoregressive sequence prediction.
blocks.zh: 指弹-PoseNet. 我们的第二个基线是基于Fingerspelling-PoseNet Fayyazsanavi等人(2023年),一种基于姿势的变压器编码器-解码器架构,旨在从手姿势序列中识别出手指. 该模型在自动被检测到的签名手的21个2D地标上运行,并进行自转序列预测.

blocks.en: Adaptation to RSL. Both baselines were transferred to RSL with minimal changes. The only modification was a configuration-level replacement of the output vocabulary with the 33 letters of the Cyrillic alphabet; the source code of both public implementations was left unchanged, so the input representation, normalization, architecture, optimizer settings, learning rate schedule, and augmentations remain the defaults released by the original authors (see Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 适应RSL. 这两项基线都移交给了登记册系统管理人,但变化很小。 唯一的修改是以西里尔字母表的33个字母来代替输出词汇的配置级别;两个公共执行的源代码没有被修改,因此输入表示,正常化,架构,优化器设置,学习速度表,和增强仍然是由原始作者发布的默认(见附录B.

blocks.en: 4.3 Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate the two baseline architectures on the held-out test split of the Znaki dataset. Table 3 reports character-level 1 − CER 1-\mathrm{CER} and phrase-level (Acc) performance.
blocks.zh: 我们在Znaki数据集的搁置测试中评估两个基线结构。 表3报告字符级1 - CER 1-\mathrm{CER}和短语级(Acc)的绩效。

blocks.en: Table 3: Baseline results on the proposed RSL fingerspelling dataset.
blocks.zh: 表3:关于拟议的登记册系统记录仪指针数据集的基准结果。

blocks.en: The Transformer-Based model, adapted from ASL to RSL, achieves strong character-level accuracy ( 1 − CER = 0.932 1-\mathrm{CER}=0.932 ) but exhibits a substantial gap at the sequence level (Acc = 0.596), indicating compounding errors in sequence prediction.
blocks.zh: 基于变形器的模型从ASL被改编为RSL,实现了强烈的字符级精度(1−CER = 0.932 1-\mathrm{CER}=0.932 ),但在序列级(Acc = 0.596)上显示出了巨大的空白,表明序列预测的复合错误.

blocks.en: Error analysis reveals three primary failure modes: • Visual confusability : high confusion rates among visually similar handshapes (e.g., ‘‘Ш’’/‘‘Щ’’ ( Sh/Shch ), ‘‘Е’’/‘‘Ё’’ ( E/Yo ), ‘‘И’’/‘‘Й’’ ( I/Y ), ‘‘Р’’/‘‘Н’’ ( R/N )), accounting for 38% of character substitutions. • Dynamic sign instability : temporal segmentation errors for movement-based handshapes ( ‘‘Д’’, ‘‘З’’, ‘‘Й’’, ‘‘Ц’’, ‘‘Щ’’ — D, Z, Y, Ts, Shch ), leading to 27% of deletions and insertions. • Length-dependent degradation : Acc decreases by 4.2% per additional character for sequences of ≥ \geq 4 letters, reflecting accumulated alignment uncertainty.

blocks.en: These baselines establish Znaki as a challenging benchmark for RSL fingerspelling recognition and provide a reference point for future methodological advances.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented Znaki — the first public fingerspelling dataset for RSL and the largest RSL fingerspelling resource to date. By involving only native and near-native members of the signing community, Znaki captures natural intra- and inter-signer variability while ensuring the linguistic authenticity of the collected data, addressing a critical gap: prior to our work, no publicly available RSL fingerspelling datasets existed.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了Znaki——第一个用于RSL的公用指尖数据集以及迄今为止最大的RSL指尖资源. Znaki只吸收签约社区的本地和近本地成员参与,在确保所收集数据语言真实性的同时,捕捉到签名人内部和签名人之间的自然可变性,解决了一个重要的差距:在我们开展工作之前,没有公开的RSL指针拼接数据集。

blocks.en: We involved RSL experts in defining the categories of lexical sequences and used LLMs to generate candidate proper names for recording. In addition, we developed a participant verification procedure for the crowdsourcing platform to improve recording quality and annotation reliability.
blocks.zh: 我们让塞拉利昂共和国专家参与界定词典序列的类别,并使用LLMs生成供记录的候选正名。 此外,我们还为众包平台制定了参与者核查程序,以提高记录质量和注释可靠性。

blocks.en: To validate the usability of the proposed dataset, we trained two publicly available strong baselines previously developed for ASL fingerspelling recognition. The successful transfer of these architectures to RSL fingerspelling demonstrates the suitability of the proposed dataset for training and evaluating modern fingerspelling recognition models.
blocks.zh: 为了验证拟议数据集的可用性,我们培训了两个公开的强基线,这些基线是以前为ASL指针识别而开发的。 这些架构被成功转移到RSL指代,表明拟议数据集适合培训和评价现代指代识别模型。

blocks.en: We believe that publicly releasing Znaki will stimulate further progress in sign language processing, particularly for under-resourced sign languages.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,公开发布Znaki将促进在手语处理方面取得进一步进展,特别是对资源不足的手语而言。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The Znaki dataset reflects the demographic composition of its participants and therefore exhibits several imbalances. The dataset was collected from signers aged 20–54 years, without representation of children or elderly signers, whose signing patterns may differ substantially. In addition, the gender distribution is imbalanced (52 women and 16 men), and all participants belong to a relatively homogeneous ethnic and geographic background. These factors may limit the generalization of models trained on Znaki to broader signer populations.
blocks.zh: 兹纳基数据集反映了其参与者的人口构成,因此显示出了几种不平衡。 数据集是从20至54岁的签字人那里收集的,没有儿童或老人签字人的代表,他们的签字模式可能大相径庭。 此外,性别分布不平衡(52名女性和16名男性),所有参与者都属于相对单一的种族和地域背景。 这些因素可能限制对接受过Znaki培训的模型的通俗化,使之仅限于更广泛的签字人口。

blocks.en: The dataset focuses exclusively on fingerspelled proper names and predefined phrase categories. As a result, it does not cover several important aspects of real-world fingerspelling communication, including numerical sequences, conversational phrases, abbreviations, partial fingerspelling, fingerspelling embedded in mixed lexical contexts (interleaved with lexical signs), and coarticulation between fingerspelling and surrounding signs in continuous signing. Although the selected phrase categories were designed in consultation with Deaf experts, the phrase distribution may not fully reflect natural fingerspelling usage frequencies in the Deaf community. More broadly, this scope is deliberate: Znaki is a fingerspelling dataset rather than a full continuous sign language recognition or translation resource, and it does not include RSL gloss annotations — fingerspelling is one component of sign language communication, not a substitute for full sign language recognition.
blocks.zh: 数据集专门侧重于指拼正名和预定义的短语类别. 因此,它没有涵盖现实世界指代沟通的几个重要方面,包括数字序列,对话短语,缩写,部分指代,嵌入于混合语法背景的指代(与语法标志相接),指代和周围标志在连续的签名中相接. 虽然选定的词组类别是与聋人专家协商设计的,但该词组分布可能不能充分反映聋人社区自然指尖使用频率. 更广泛地说,这一范围是深思熟虑的: Znaki是一个指心语数据集,而不是一个完整的连续的手语识别或翻译资源,它并不包括RSL花样语注解——指心语是手语通信的一个组成部分,不是完全的手语识别的替代.

blocks.en: The annotations provide only sequence-level temporal boundaries (start and end of fingerspelling); frame-level and letter-level segmentation is not available. This limits the direct use of Znaki for research on letter-to-frame alignment, fine-grained temporal modeling of handshape transitions, and fingerspelling detection within continuous signing. Adding letter-level temporal annotations is a natural direction for future extensions of the dataset.
blocks.zh: 注释仅提供序列级时间界限(指针的起止;帧级和字母级分解不可用. 这限制了Znaki直接用于字母对帧对接,手巾过渡的精细时间模型化研究,以及在连续签名内指尖检测的研究. 添加字母级时间说明是数据集未来扩展的自然方向.

blocks.en: The recording setup also introduces several constraints. Most videos were recorded using smartphone cameras in frontal-view settings, with limited variation in viewpoint. The dataset does not explicitly cover challenging scenarios such as severe occlusions, extreme lighting conditions, or multi-view recordings.
blocks.zh: 录音设置也引入了几种限制. 大多数视频是在前视设置中使用智能手机相机录制的,视角差异有限. 数据集没有明确涵盖有挑战性的情景,如严重隐蔽、极端照明条件或多视图录音等。

blocks.en: Our experimental evaluation is limited to two publicly available baseline architectures originally developed for ASL fingerspelling recognition. Therefore, the reported results should be viewed as initial baselines rather than exhaustive performance estimates for the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验评价仅限于最初为ASL指尖识别而开发的两种公开基准架构. 因此,报告的结果应被视为初步基线,而不是数据集的详尽业绩估计。

blocks.en: Ethical Statement
blocks.zh: 道德声明

blocks.en: The legal and ethical aspects of the dataset collection procedure were reviewed and approved by our institution’s legal team. All crowdworkers provided informed consent through the crowdsourcing platform, authorizing the processing and public release of their data for research purposes. Participation in the project was voluntary, and all contributors received financial compensation proportional to the time required for task completion. Compensation rates were aligned with the average income levels in the Russian Federation.
blocks.zh: 我们机构的法律小组审查和批准了数据集收集程序的法律和道德方面。 所有人群工作者通过众包平台提供知情同意,授权为研究目的处理并公开发布其数据。 参加该项目是自愿的,所有捐助者都得到与完成任务所需时间相称的财政补偿。 补偿率与俄罗斯联邦的平均收入水平一致。

blocks.en: To protect participant privacy, all contributors were identified only through anonymized hash-based user identifiers. Since facial expressions and non-manual components constitute an essential part of sign language communication, facial information was retained in the recordings and may be misused in surveillance-related applications.
blocks.zh: 为保护参与者隐私,所有贡献者只能通过匿名散列式用户标识识别。 由于面部表情和非手语成分构成手语交流的基本部分,面部信息被保留在录音中,可能会被滥用于与监视有关的应用.

blocks.en: To mitigate such risks, the dataset is released exclusively for research purposes under a restricted-use license.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这种风险,数据集只根据限制使用许可证为研究目的发布。

blocks.en: Appendix B Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训详情

blocks.en: Both baselines were trained on the training split with early stopping on the validation split, using the default hyperparameters of the respective public implementations Henkel (2023) ; Fayyazsanavi et al. (2023) . We did not modify the source code of either repository: the training procedure, optimizer settings, learning rate schedule, and augmentations were kept exactly as released by the original authors, so the exact values can be found in the corresponding public repositories. The only adaptation required for RSL was a configuration-level change of the output vocabulary, replacing the original character set with the 33 letters of the Cyrillic alphabet. Each model was trained for approximately 14 hours on a single H100 80 GB GPU.
blocks.zh: 两个基线都接受了关于培训分解的培训,并及早停止验证分解,使用各自公开执行的默认超参数Henkel(2023);Fayyazsanavi等人(2023)。 我们没有修改两个寄存器的源代码:培训程序,优化器设置,学习速率表,和增强器都与原作者所发布的完全一样,所以确切值可以在相应的公共寄存器中找到. RSL唯一的需要修改的是输出词汇的配置级别变化,用西里尔字母表的33个字母取代了原来的字符集. 每个型号在单个H100 80GB GPU上接受了约14小时的培训.
